verdict.info: \bBelievitanducan\p has swept all before him this season but there is more for him to prove over this extreme trip and on ground firmer than good. \bDEFIANTLY (nap)\p therefore has the most persuasive piece of evidence with his defiant second over 2m4f at Royal Ascot, and that race is also a positive pointer to the chance of \bAnnabel's Ghost\p, who is second choice. \bMaxi King\p has strong each-way claims, while \bAlphonse Le Grande\p hinted at a revival behind Believitanducan at Newcastle and \bHighwind\p will be probably figure prominently. \bValiancy\p is the seriously unexposed contender regarding a major stamina test.[Richard Austen]
